comments.text_zh: > 我曾是 Nicky Verstappen [1] 案中被要求提供 DNA 样本的那群人中的一员。这是自愿的，而我很不情愿地做了这件事。很棒的故事，谢谢分享。不过，我想回应一下为什么我认为这是个坏主意。首先，在做这件事之前，我会先咨询辩护律师。关于这个话题有一个著名视频在这里[VIDEO]。1）警察可能告诉你这是为了某个案子，但其实是为了另一个案子，因为警察可以说谎。2）DNA 检测本身可能对你或你的家庭成员产生假阳性，让你的家人受到警方比原本更严厉的审查，而且更有司法依据。在调查热情中，他们可能发现其他较轻的罪行，并为了不空手而归而想起诉。在美国，他们可能因为一个假阳性就以荒谬地夸大严重的罪名起诉某位家庭成员。有人因为这种起诉手法而自杀（[LINK]）。3）如果警察认为你或其他人做了这件事，他们可能篡改样本并栽赃证据。（Steven Avery 案）4）如果实验室与 DA 串通，他们可能伪造结果（[LINK]）。做出那个选择时，你是在拿自己的生命和家人的生命赌博。而如果你如此确信你的某个家人没做这件事，那么警察也可能根据他们的不在场证明和你家人的身体状态得出同样结论。即使你相信这些没有一件“很可能发生”
comments.text: > I've been part of the group who got asked to give a DNA sample in the Nicky Verstappen [1] case. This was voluntarily, and I reluctantly did this Great story and thanks for sharing this. I want to answer why I think this is a bad idea however. First, I would talk to a legal defense attorney before doing this. A famous video about this topic is here [VIDEO] . 1) The police might have told you it was for one case but it was for another, as the police can lie. 2) The DNA test itself might give a false positive on you or your family members, putting your family to a harsher scrutiny by the police that would have otherwise, and with more judicial justification. In the investigatory zeal they might find other lesser crimes they might want to prosecute just to not be empty handed. In the U.S., they might have charged a family member on a false positive with a ridiculously overblown crime. People have killed themselves over that prosecutorial technique ( [LINK] ) 3) The police could fiddle with the samples and plant evidence if they thought you or someone else did it. (Steven Avery case) 4) The lab might fake results if they are in tandem with the DA ( [LINK] ) You are gambling with your life and the life of your family members when you make that choice. And if you were so sure a family member of yours did not do it, then the police could have come to the same conclusion on their alibis and physical state of your family members. Even if you believe non of that is "likely to happen"

In scenario (1), they're going to charge you with a crime no matter what you say - they already have enough evidence. And anything you say to the police in this scenario can only be used as evidence against you to further strengthen the police's case, it cannot be used in your own defense in court. comments.story_title: AI surveillance should be banned while there is still time
comments.why_zh: 老视频讲不要和警察说话，现在扩展到监控
comments.text_zh: 我怎么强调自己对 AI 监控被使用的恐惧都不为过。最糟的是，你对此无能为力。不管我在网上多么注重隐私，只要我发送东西的对象不重视隐私，比如说用 AI 来总结邮件，那我也就进了 AI 数据库。然后还有日常被爬取的数据，比如银行记录等等。我是说，我镇上有个停车场在用 AI 摄像头追踪停车场里的人并给他们计费！我镇上的人在向停车场业主施压，要求他撤掉它，但显然那家公司因为这套东西装在他场里而给了他太多钱。就像那个老视频说的「Don't talk to the Police」[1]，但现在我们得把它扩展成「Don't Do Anything」，因为你做的每件事都被喂进了一个可能会被搜索的数据库。
comments.text: I cannot understate how afraid I am of the use of AI Surveillance. The worst thing is there is nothing you can do about it. It does not matter how private I am online, if the person I am sending things to is not privacy conscious and, say, uses AI to summarize emails, then I am in the AI database. And then there is just the day to day data being scraped, like bank records, etc. I mean a PARKING LOT in my town is using AI cameras to track and bill people in a parking lot! The people of my town are putting pressure on the parking lot owner to get rid of it but apparently the company is paying him too much money for having it in his lot. Like the old video says "Don't talk to the Police" [1], but now we have to expand it to say "Don't Do Anything", because everything you do is being fed into a database that can possibly be searched.
